Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Nyra and the Garden of Moros, a third-person exploration adventure game developed by Resting Relic. Watch the Gameplay Launch Trailer for Nivalis Nights, a cyberpunk life management game developed by Ion Lands. Players will design societies to their exact specification with establishing apartments, growing businesses, and managing a cyberpunk city. Nivalis Nights is available now on PC (Steam).

title: Nivalis Nights - Official Gameplay Launch Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: IGN
description:
Meet the voice actors of Cresata (including Aleks Le and Ben Starr) and watch them perform lines in this new trailer for Cresata, an upcoming action platformer game. The new trailer also showcases gameplay, its world, and what to expect. Cresata will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

From the ashes. In the name of vengeance. A revenant shall rise. Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

author: IGN
description:
Coral Island gets a new trailer announcing a new update and a Nintendo Switch 2 reveal. Watch the latest Coral Island trailer to learn more about gameplay, what to expect from the farm sim, Nintendo Switch 2 features, and the new Kids Grow-Up 1.4 update. Coral Island is available now on PC (Steam), Windows PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). The Kids Grow-Up update will be available in winter 2026, alongside its launch on Nintendo Switch 2.

#ign #gaming

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the trailer for Abelina, an upcoming surreal, hand-crafted adventure platformer game. You died and woke up here in Abelina. Now you're heading out into the frontier with your companions following behind. There is no combat, instead you explore a vast world and a mature story about carrying life's baggage into the afterlife. Abelina will be available on PC. A demo will be out on Steam this November 2026.

#ign #gaming
title: Abelina - Official Demo Announce Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

description:
Get a close look at how the Class System works in this latest video for the action RPG, No Rest for the Wicked. The new video also showcases new factions you can join to experience Isola Sacra, along with other improvements coming to version 1.0. The Class System arrives in No Rest for the Wicked when version 1.0 launches on PC and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in March 2027. It will also be available during the Open Beta test coming in December 2026.
